param.name: input_crs
param.label: Input CRS
param.help: Coordinate Reference System (CRS) of the input coordinates, e.g., 'EPSG:4326' for WGS84.

param.name: output_crs
param.label: Output CRS
param.help: Coordinate Reference System (CRS) of the output coordinates, e.g., 'EPSG:3857' for Web Mercator.

param.name: csv
param.label: Input CSV
param.help: CSV file containing coordinates to be transformed. Must include columns for latitude and longitude.

param.name: lat_col
param.label: Latitude Column
param.help: Name of the column in the input CSV that contains latitude values.

param.name: lon_col
param.label: Longitude Column
param.help: Name of the column in the input CSV that contains longitude values.

param.name: wkt_col
param.label: WKT Geometry Column (optional)
param.help: Name of the column containing WKT geometries to reproject. When provided, lat/lon columns are ignored and a new reprojected WKT geometry column is added instead.

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Reprojects coordinates or WKT geometries from one Coordinate Reference System (CRS) to another using the `pyproj <https://pyproj4.github.io/pyproj/>`_ library.
Two modes are available depending on whether a WKT column is provided:
- **Lat/Lon mode** *(default)* — reads plain latitude and longitude columns and writes two new columns with the reprojected X/Y values. - **WKT mode** — reads a column of WKT geometries (e.g. ``POINT``, ``LINESTRING``, ``POLYGON``) and writes a new column with the reprojected geometries in WKT format.
-----
**Inputs**
+---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+ | Parameter | Required | Description | +=====================+==========+==========================================================+ | Input CRS | Yes | CRS of the source data (e.g. ``EPSG:4326`` for WGS 84). | +---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+ | Output CRS | Yes | Target CRS (e.g. ``EPSG:3857`` for Web Mercator). | +---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+ | Input CSV | Yes | CSV file containing the coordinates to transform. | +---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+ | Latitude Column | Yes | Name of the column holding latitude values. | +---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+ | Longitude Column | Yes | Name of the column holding longitude values. | +---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+ | WKT Geometry Column | No | Name of the column holding WKT geometries. When set, | | | | lat/lon columns are ignored and geometry reprojection | | | | is performed instead. | +---------------------+----------+----------------------------------------------------------+
-----
**Output**
A CSV file containing all original columns plus:
- **Lat/Lon mode**: two added columns named ``<lon_col>_<output_crs>`` and ``<lat_col>_<output_crs>``. The original coordinate columns are renamed to ``<col>_<input_crs>`` for traceability. - **WKT mode**: one added column named ``<wkt_col>_<output_crs>`` containing the reprojected WKT geometries.
-----
**Examples**
*Lat/Lon mode* — reproject WGS 84 coordinates to Web Mercator::
Input CRS: EPSG:4326 Output CRS: EPSG:3857 Latitude Column: latitude Longitude Column: longitude
*WKT mode* — reproject WGS 84 linestrings to Web Mercator::
Input CRS: EPSG:4326 Output CRS: EPSG:3857 WKT Geometry Column: wkt
-----
**Common EPSG codes**
- ``EPSG:4326`` — WGS 84 (GPS latitude/longitude) - ``EPSG:3857`` — Web Mercator (Google Maps, OpenStreetMap) - ``EPSG:2154`` — RGF93 / Lambert-93 (France) - ``EPSG:27572`` — NTF / Lambert Zone II (legacy France) - ``EPSG:32631`` — WGS 84 / UTM zone 31N
